stories.headline: Bihar makhana reaches Greece: APEDA flags off 1-tonne Purnea consignment
stories.summary: APEDA facilitated the flag-off of a 1-metric-tonne consignment of popped (Phool) makhana from Purnea, Bihar to Greece on October 2, 2026 — the first direct commercial shipment under APEDA's export diversification programme. Sourced by Indo Global Export (Belouri, Purnea) and shipped via S.S. Foods Exports (New Delhi), the cargo travels Mundra Port to Piraeus. The Commerce Ministry says it fetched higher price realisation than the prevailing domestic market rate. The flag-off was chaired by Bihar Agriculture Minister Vijay Kumar Sinha with APEDA Chairman Abhishek Dev present. Context: India exported 7,000+ MT of makhana worth USD 22 million in FY 2025-26 to 20+ markets; Bihar grows 80-85% of India's makhana across 35,000+ hectares in 10 districts, and the state is drafting an Agri Export Policy.
stories.brief: Bihar makhana reaches Greece: APEDA flags off 1-tonne Purnea consignment. An economy-related story. Covered by 4 outlets, including DD India and The Tribune.

stories.headline: New Mokama rail bridge ready: trains may start October 5 after CRS safety inspection
stories.summary: The new double-line rail bridge over the Ganga at Mokama, built parallel to Rajendra Setu at a cost of Rs 1,491 crore, may open for train services on October 5, 2026, pending the Commissioner of Railway Safety's two-day inspection (Oct 3-4) covering the bridge structure, tracks, signalling, electrification and the 13-km Mokama-Rampur Dumra section upgrades. Trains could run at up to 90 kmph versus 40-50 kmph on the old bridge. A mega block until Oct 4 for non-interlocking work has cancelled or rerouted hundreds of trains in the Mokama-Barauni-Hathidah section; regular operations depend on final safety clearance.
stories.brief: New Mokama rail bridge ready: trains may start October 5 after CRS safety inspection. Covered by 4 outlets, including Patna Press and The Times of India.

Services include the weekly Chelapalli–Danapur special (Oct 4–Nov 29), Hyderabad–Danapur (Oct 3–Nov 30), Chelapalli–Sasaram, Patna–Chelapalli, Chandigarh–Patna, Ferozepur Cantt–Patna and a daily Anand Vihar–Patliputra service from October 1 to November 30.

Rainfall activity is expected to remain weak from September 30 to October 3, with rain expected to return from October 3–4. Bihar has recorded 31% less rainfall than normal this monsoon season.

stories.summary: After reports that Congress leader Sonia Gandhi called former Bihar CM Nitish Kumar a 'traitor' at a Congress Working Committee meeting in Delhi, JD(U) leaders responded sharply on October 1. Union minister Rajiv Ranjan Singh 'Lalan' said Kumar 'does not need Sonia Gandhi's certificate', working president Sanjay Jha said the Congress was belatedly realising Kumar's value, and Bihar minister Ashok Choudhary called Kumar a 'Vikas Purush'.

stories.summary: Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary announced at the Rising Bihar Investor Summit 2026, held October 1 at Hotel Taj City Centre, Patna, that the state government will purchase 25% of products manufactured by Bihar-based industries if they meet prescribed quality standards. He said the government is revising its procurement policy to give priority to in-state manufacturers and is building roads, power and water infrastructure to support industrial growth.

stories.headline: Patna startup Navmarg among 54 finalists in Vande Bharatam innovation campaign
stories.summary: Navmarg Research and Innovation Private Limited, a Patna-based startup, was selected among 54 finalists from around 26,000 participants in the nationwide Vande Bharatam entrepreneurship and innovation campaign. Co-founders Arpit Kumar and Abhijit Kumar also earned a place in a 10-day special mentorship programme. Navmarg's patented MARU magnetic-separation system removes arsenic from drinking water without chemical dosing and has delivered over 3.19 million litres of safe water in field deployments.

stories.summary: Cricketer Vaibhav Suryavanshi has been named to TIME's TIME100 Next 2026 list of 100 rising figures shaping the future, featuring in the 'Phenom' category. At 15, he is the youngest person on this year's list and the only Indian athlete among seven athletes selected. His rapid rise includes an IPL debut for Rajasthan Royals, a 35-ball IPL century, and a starring role in India's ICC Under-19 World Cup 2026 title win where he scored 175 in the final.

stories.summary: The Economic Offences Unit registered a disproportionate-assets case against Amit Kumar Gupta, an Enforcement Sub-Inspector in Bihar's Transport Department, alleging assets worth Rs 1,49,58,500 — about 148.10% beyond his known legitimate income during 13 years of service. Searches at his Patna (Sai Vardaan City, Danapur) and Ara/Awadhpuri (Bhojpur) premises recovered around Rs 3 lakh in cash, an electric car, documents for 11 plots across Ara, Patna and Chhapra, and passbooks/chequebooks linked to 15 bank accounts, with funds frozen and a bank locker identified for a further search.

Police are scanning CCTV footage and Digha SHO Avnish Kumar clarified no firearm was used.
stories.brief: Twin chain-snatchings in Patna's Kurji and Gardanibagh; Rs 12 lakh in gold stolen within hours. A crime-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including Patna Press and Punjab Kesari (IANS).

stories.summary: The Union Home Ministry and Ministry of External Affairs alerted Bihar police after it emerged that 31 Afghan nationals — 30 issued against Patna addresses and one against a Darbhanga address — obtained Indian passports through fraudulent means, alongside two Bangladeshi nationals. The MHA/MEA directed district magistrates and SSPs/SPs across the state to investigate and report, placing the police verification process used for passport issuance under scrutiny.

stories.summary: Bihar's Vigilance Bureau raided the premises of Patna ADM (Supply) Ravindra Kumar Diwakar and his wife Kumari Sweety, a sub-registrar in Begusarai, recovering about Rs 79.98 lakh in cash (Rs 70.53 lakh from their Patna flat and Rs 9.44 lakh in Begusarai), jewellery worth about Rs 52.6 lakh, 48 expensive watches valued at about Rs 6 lakh, and seven immovable properties with a declared value of about Rs 2.92 crore. stories.brief: Vigilance raids Patna ADM (Supply) Ravindra Kumar Diwakar and sub-registrar wife; Rs 79.98 lakh cash and 48 watches seized. A crime-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including Indian Express and ETV Bharat.

stories.summary: Patna Municipal Corporation collected a record Rs 3.61 crore-plus in property tax from more than 1,900 properties on the last penalty-free day, the highest single-day property tax collection of the current financial year, surpassing the previous record of Rs 3.36 crore set on June 30. The New Capital Circle led with Rs 2.08 crore from 397 properties; the civic body also brought 303 new properties into the tax net, and counters stayed open late as 1.5% monthly penalties kicked in after the deadline.

stories.summary: The IMD has warned of heavy rainfall accompanied by storms and lightning across many Bihar districts including Patna, as a depression over the Bay of Bengal moves in. After a largely dry September 21, rain is expected to pick up again from around September 23.
stories.brief: IMD warns of heavy rain, storms across Bihar including Patna. A weather-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including Top Indian News and Facebook (Dainik Jagran).

stories.headline: Bihar UGMAC 2026 Round 2 rank cards released; choice locking open
stories.summary: The Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board released the UGMAC 2026 Round 2 rank cards for MBBS, BDS, BVSc and BFSc counselling. Choice filling and locking continue, with provisional seat allotment scheduled for September 25.
stories.brief: Bihar UGMAC 2026 Round 2 rank cards released; choice locking open. An education-related story. Covered by CollegeDekho and Jagran Josh.

stories.headline: Minor student alleges sexual assault in Patna's Shastrinagar; FIR filed
stories.summary: A minor college student alleged she was sexually assaulted by a young man she knew in the Shastrinagar area. Police registered an FIR, conducted a medical examination, and are tracing the accused using a mobile number. The allegation is under investigation. Single source — treat with caution.
stories.brief: Minor student alleges sexual assault in Patna's Shastrinagar; FIR filed. A crime-related story. So far carried by Patna Press.

stories.headline: 'The Vvaan' film team meets Bihar CM; Chhath traditions praised
stories.summary: The team of the folklore-fantasy film 'The Vvaan: Force of the Forrest' (starring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia) met Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary in Patna after observing Chhath Puja. The CM appreciated the film for bringing Bihar's traditions to mainstream Hindi cinema. Single source — treat with caution.
stories.brief: 'The Vvaan' film team meets Bihar CM; Chhath traditions praised. So far carried by Bollywood Hungama.

stories.headline: Rail mega block Sep 21–Oct 4 to hit Bihar train services
stories.summary: Railways will take a mega block for track-doubling work affecting train operations in Bihar from September 21 to October 4, according to a News18 Bihar/Jharkhand report. Passengers should check schedules. Single source — treat with caution.
stories.brief: Rail mega block Sep 21–Oct 4 to hit Bihar train services. A civic-infrastructure story. So far carried by Facebook (News18 Bihar/Jharkhand).

stories.headline: Patna Police bust international cyber fraud network, arrest four
stories.summary: Patna Police busted a cyber fraud network operating from the Musallahpur area and arrested four people accused of targeting customers in India and abroad — allegedly using malware, APKs and internet-based calling to pose as tech support and demand money for fake computer repairs. Around Rs 3.5 lakh in linked bank accounts has been frozen.
stories.brief: Patna Police bust international cyber fraud network, arrest four. A crime-related story. Covered by 3 outlets, including Patna Press and The420.in.

stories.headline: Over 35 Munger Engineering College students fall ill; food poisoning suspected
stories.summary: Panic at Munger Engineering College hostel after more than three dozen students — and some staff — fell ill with vomiting, diarrhoea, fever and weakness. They were treated at Sadar Hospital and most were discharged. Vishwakarma Puja prasad served on campus is suspected, but the exact cause is unconfirmed and an enquiry has been ordered.
stories.brief: Over 35 Munger Engineering College students fall ill; food poisoning suspected. A health-related story. Covered by 4 outlets, including hi INDIA (IANS) and BizzBuzz.

stories.headline: Patna airport steps up bird-strike prevention drive
stories.summary: Authorities announced fresh measures to reduce bird-strike risk at Patna's Jayprakash Narayan International Airport — curbs on garbage heaps, meat and fish shops and laser lights within about 10 km of the airport. The move follows recent bird-related flight disruptions, including an IndiGo diversion to Varanasi.
stories.brief: Patna airport steps up bird-strike prevention drive. A civic-infrastructure story. Covered by Facebook (News18 Bihar/Jharkhand) and Patna Press.

stories.headline: Patna Civil Court evacuated after email bomb threat; nothing found
stories.summary: Patna Civil Court received a bomb threat by email, prompting evacuation of the premises and searches by police, bomb disposal and dog squads. No suspicious object was found. It is the latest in a recurring series of hoax email threats to the court.
stories.brief: Patna Civil Court evacuated after email bomb threat; nothing found. A crime-related story. Covered by Facebook (NBT Bihar) and Patna Press.

stories.headline: Liquor smuggling via Ganga river route busted near Patna
stories.summary: Police busted a liquor smuggling operation that was allegedly using the Ganga river as a waterway to ferry alcohol from Uttar Pradesh into prohibition-state Bihar, according to a News18 Bihar/Jharkhand report. Single source — treat with caution.
stories.brief: Liquor smuggling via Ganga river route busted near Patna. A crime-related story. So far carried by Facebook (News18 Bihar/Jharkhand).

stories.headline: Minor girl allegedly pushed from moving Patna-Ara train; stable
stories.summary: A minor girl was allegedly pushed from a moving Patna-Ara passenger train near Phulwari Sharif station. She was taken to hospital and reported stable. Railway police are investigating; the exact circumstances remain unclear according to police. Single source — treat with caution.
stories.brief: Minor girl allegedly pushed from moving Patna-Ara train; stable. A crime-related story. So far carried by Patna Press.

stories.headline: BPSC, Daroga aspirants march in Patna over alleged paper leaks; clash with police
stories.summary: Thousands of government job aspirants marched from Gandhi Maidan toward the CM's residence demanding cancellation and re-examination of the 70th BPSC exam and Daroga (sub-inspector) recruitment over alleged irregularities. Protesters pushed against police barricades at JP Golambar and Dak Bangla Chauraha; police resorted to lathi-charge.
stories.brief: BPSC, Daroga aspirants march in Patna over alleged paper leaks; clash with police. A politics-related story. Covered by 6 outlets, including Instagram (PTI photos) and Facebook (Jagran Josh).
